subject: English
question_text: The graph below shows "Total Candidates in SSC
stimulus: Examination-2013. Describes the graph in 150 words. You should highlight and summaries the information given in the graph. 10 Total candidates in SSC Examination-2013
guide_solution: Graph & charts Here in the graph, the total number of candidates in SSC Examination-2013 has been shown in three groups namely. Science, Humanities and Business Studies. In all groups, male candidates are shown through deep pink coloured columns and female ones are shown through light pink coloured ones. In case of Science, we see male students are 41,812 while female ones are 29,660. So, the boys outnumber the girls by 12, 152. In Humanities, boys are 32,776 and girls are 62,630. Then girls have outnumbered the boys by almost two times. In Business Studies, male candidates are shown to be 83,547 and female ones 66.941. So, the males outnumber the females by 16,606. In conclusion, we can say in Science and Business studies the males surpass. considerably, but in Humanities, females far outnumber the males. In this graph, the choices of studies vary to a great extent. It is natural that the female students are more fond of studying Humanities group the other two ones. The male students are, on the other hand, more fond, of Science and Business Studies groups than Humanities group.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 150 — Udayan Secondary School, Barisal

subject: English
question_text: Suppose you are Rahim. Your friend is Nadib. Now write
stimulus: a dialogue between you and your friend about a cricket match Bangladesh VS Pakistan. 10
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself and my friend Nadib about an interesting and exciting cricket match between Bangladesh and Pakistan. Myself : Hello Abed! How did you enjoy the final match of the Twenty-20 World Cup Cricket? Nadib : Oh! It was really very exciting. I really enjoyed it. My favourite team became the champion. Myself : I was greatly disheartened (হতাশ). I really can't accept the defeat of my favourite cricket team in the final match. Nadib : Don't you think, the better team gets the final trophy? First Paper  Solutions Myself : I think, Pakistan Cricket Team is no less good than India. Nadib : But you must admit that on the day, India definitely out played Pakistan. Myself : That's true, Pakistan batting order crumbled (ভেঙ্গে পড়া) unfortunately and brought this defeat.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 150 — Udayan Secondary School, Barisal
